top_signals.title: Goldman Sachs Sees 19% Return on Asia ex-Japan Stocks in 2027
top_signals.summary: Goldman Sachs expects earnings growth to drive a 19% return for the MSCI Asia ex-Japan Index in dollar terms next year, even as it warned that uncertainty over artificial intelligence could fuel volatility.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Tech Firms Dismantle Botnet That Turned 1.3M TV Boxes Into Proxies
top_signals.summary: Google said today it worked with industry partners to dismantle a botnet made up of more than 1.3 million Android TV set-top boxes that ship with malicious software which secretly rents the user's Internet connection out to strangers and conducts advertising fraud. Experts involved in the takedown say the action is likely to sever the botnet's access to more than 10 million additional compromised systems, including other Internet of Things (IoT) products such as Android-based healthcare devices and karaoke machines.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
